subject.title: Per-agent tools.selfDeny — allow tool inheritance to subagents while denying direct use

question: Should OpenClaw add an explicit delegate-only/self-deny tool policy for requester agents, and which public config shape should own that behavior?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the fix adds public config surface and changes how security-sensitive tool-deny inheritance works between requester agents and subagents.

options.title: Approve delegate-only config
options.body: Add an optional per-agent policy that hides listed tools from the requester model while preserving deny-wins behavior and controlled child inheritance.

options.title: Fold into per-spawn policy
options.body: Use the per-spawn toolsAllow direction for child narrowing and document that parent direct-use prevention still requires separate agent profiles or prompt guidance until a later design.

options.title: Keep monotonic inheritance
options.body: Reject parent-deny delegation for now and document the separate-agent workaround and security rationale.

recommendation.title: Approve delegate-only config
recommendation.body: Add an optional per-agent policy that hides listed tools from the requester model while preserving deny-wins behavior and controlled child inheritance.
